items.claim: 主持人聲明本場不提供前瞻性量化評論
items.quote: there will be no forward-looking quantitative comments
items.speaker: Mike Wang

items.claim: CFO 將毛利/營運槓桿壓力歸因於世代轉換：舊品下滑、新世代爬坡初期、產能利用率與產品組合尚未到位
items.quote: our legacy solution are declining as expected, while next-generation programs are still in early stage of ramp
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 列出重疊期的三項壓力來源：舊品價格正常化、新案爬坡低效率、多世代並行的營運複雜度
items.quote: legacy pricing normalization, early-stage ramp inefficiency for newer programs and elevated operational complexity
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 稱目前毛利狀況屬轉換與重疊階段，並非長期軌跡改變
items.quote: the current margin profile is best understood as part of the transition and overlap phases
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 稱長期營運槓桿不變但逐季未必線性，並提到本季營業利益層級顯示費用控管
items.quote: it still show that we have strong OpEx discipline
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 描述新平台初期的成本結構：量小、前期工程與營運成本高
items.quote: newer platform typically begin with lower initial volume and higher upfront engineering and operational costs
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 銅與 PVC 原料成本持續上升，引發部分供應鏈的價格討論，公司選擇性調價
items.quote: We are selectively adjusting pricing where appropriate while continuing to support customer ramp requirements.
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 供應鏈緩衝庫存與急單減少，部署時程差異在近期更為明顯
items.quote: which means timing difference are more visible in the near term
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 擴產與營運整備可能暫時影響近期效率
items.quote: this effort may temporarily impact near-term efficiency
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 家電業務在部分品類因產業產能過剩與客戶競爭而仍具競爭性壓力
items.quote: electrical appliances remain competitive across selected product categories due to industry overcapacity
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 工業與車用狀況逐步改善，來自特定客戶活動與試產案
items.quote: industrial and automotive conditions continue improving gradually
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 半導體設備端近期投資節奏較為溫和，但能見度仍屬健康
items.quote: a more measured near-term investment cadence in certain areas of semiconductor ecosystem
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: COO 稱檳城的主要挑戰在營運擴張與勞動力能力培養，而非需求
items.quote: our primary challenge remains operational scaling and labor capability development rather than demand generation
items.speaker: Florian Hettich (COO)

items.claim: COO 稱 AI 基礎設施趨向機櫃層級設計
items.quote: One of the clearest shifts is that AI infrastructure is becoming rack-centric.
items.speaker: Florian Hettich (COO)

items.claim: HPC 布局涵蓋銅互連、光連接與電源傳輸三層
items.quote: copper interconnect, optical connectivity and power delivery
items.speaker: Hwa-Tse Liang (Chairman)

items.claim: 董事長稱公司策略不依賴單一架構結果，多種電源／光／互連路線將並存多年
items.quote: our strategy is not dependent on any single architecture outcome
items.speaker: Hwa-Tse Liang (Chairman)

items.claim: CEO 說明鑫福盛（XFS）自 1 月初併入，Q1 反映與 2025 大致一致的基線
items.quote: we consolidated the business starting early January
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 指出 4 月活動明顯回升，但仍定性為早期階段
items.quote: particularly into April, is a meaningful pickup in activities
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 表示需再觀察數季穩定表現才對 XFS 軌跡下結論
items.quote: we would prefer to see a few more quarters of consistency before drawing firm conclusions on the trajectory
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: XFS 近期營收貢獻取決於客戶部署步調與時程
items.quote: near-term revenue contribution will still depend on the pace and timing of customer deployments
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: COO 回應銅 vs 光：不視為二元取代，兩者並存
items.quote: we do not view this as a binary transition where one technology is just replaced by another
items.speaker: Florian Hettich (COO)

items.claim: CFO 說明資本支出採能見度驅動、紀律式節奏，擴產地點含 Batam、Tainan、Penang、Johor、Vietnam
items.quote: disciplined and visibility driven rather than speculating
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 稱投資步調對應客戶專案能見度與營運成熟度，而非短期需求波動
items.quote: pacing investment alongside customer program visibility and operational maturity
items.speaker: Charles Tsai (CFO)

items.claim: 董事長稱長期併購策略不變，採能力導向、選擇性，並維持估值與整合紀律
items.quote: long-term M&A strategy remains the same, unchanged
items.speaker: Hwa-Tse Liang (Chairman)

items.claim: CEO 稱目標不在單純加快成長，而是建立可跨週期擴展的長期能力
items.quote: our objective is not simply to grow faster
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱處於 AI 基礎設施投資週期的非常早期階段；季度部署時程仍會變動
items.quote: we are, again, in a very early stage of the AI total development investment cycle
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 稱季度部署時程仍可能因客戶排程而變動，但整體建置呈多年累積性質
items.quote: quarterly deployment timing can still vary depending on customer schedules
items.speaker: Chien-Hua Teng (CEO)

items.claim: COO 稱電壓提升由物理與效率驅動，客戶仍在評估不同 HVDC 與機櫃配電方案，預期多路徑並存
items.quote: we are therefore, expect multiple pathways to coexist
items.speaker: Florian Hettich (COO)

qa_flags.question: 毛利低於預期的具體原因與復原路徑（Morgan Stanley、BofA 等）
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層以世代轉換／產業結構論述作答，未給出毛利數字、各項壓力的量化拆解或復原時點；僅稱「隨新案放量自然抵銷」

qa_flags.question: 光學／XFS 的商機與放量軌跡
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給 XFS 營收或放量數字；稱 Q1 為與 2025 一致的基線、4 月回升，並表示需數季一致表現才下結論

qa_flags.question: 營運槓桿與長期獲利力（含工程密集度與光學投資）
qa_flags.response_pattern: 僅稱長期槓桿「intact」、路徑逐季不線性，未給時點或幅度

qa_flags.question: CapEx 與製造擴張規模；HPC 能見度；48/54V 與 800V HVDC 母排 ASP 差距
qa_flags.response_pattern: CapEx 與能見度問題未給金額或訂單量；ASP 提升幅度的提問未被直接回答，改談物理與架構
